title: Over Protected
description: Ever wanted to wear your entire wardrobe? No? Well now you can!
body:
Every explored a massive dungeon or faught a horde of mods and got super cool loot? Ever wished you could just wear all of it instead of min maxing or pixked just one? Well with this mod you cna now wear your entire armory! Just make the armor strap, throw in your armor, and put it on! All effects, enchantments, and even stat boosts (like from Apotheosis) will carry over!

Now, you may be thinking "Thats super OP!!!" and yes, I agree. So I balanced it by making ALL armor pieces in the straps take damage equaly, but mending will repair by priority. So if you got 5 Diamond Chestplates with mending, all of them will take the same amount of damage, but when mending is applied only the one on the left will get it until it is full, then the next one, then the next, then the next. So if you arent careful, the armor on the right will end up breaking.

I know that isnt much for balancing but this mod isnt ment to be. If you want it to be balanced add a mod like improved mobs or something that adds difficulty scaling. I might change how its balanced later, if you have any suggestions or recommendations then feel free to share!
